content:
Good afternoon, everyone. Thank you for joining us today for Apple's fiscal first quarter 2025 earnings call.

I'm Tim Cook, CEO of Apple. We're reporting another strong quarter with revenue of $124.3 billion, up 4% year over year. This represents a new all-time revenue record.

Our iPhone revenue came in at $71.0 billion, reflecting strong demand for the iPhone 16 lineup. Services revenue reached $26.3 billion, continuing its remarkable growth trajectory with a 14% increase year over year.

We are seeing incredible momentum in our AI initiatives with Apple Intelligence. The adoption rate has exceeded our initial projections, and we believe this positions us well for continued growth.

Now let me turn it over to Luca for the financial details.

Thank you, Tim. As Tim mentioned, total revenue was $124.3 billion. Gross margin was 46.9%, up 80 basis points from the year-ago quarter, driven by favorable mix and cost efficiencies.

Operating expenses were $15.4 billion, reflecting our continued investment in R&D, particularly in AI and machine learning capabilities.

We generated $36.1 billion in operating cash flow during the quarter, and we returned over $30 billion to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases.

Looking ahead to Q2, we expect revenue between $95 billion and $98 billion, representing mid-single-digit year-over-year growth.
